title: Build Output: Wheel and SDist
description: python -m build creates two files: a wheel (.whl) for fast binary install and a source distribution (.tar.gz) as fallback.

steps.description: Directory: dist/ contains the built artifacts.
Wheel: my_agent-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl is the pre-built binary archive for fast installs.
Sdist: my_agent-0.1.0.tar.gz is the source distribution fallback for platforms without pre-built wheels.
